cards.more: Room is the solid line, the street dotted, the model dashed, the line itself dashed red. Where a distance has no source its trace is absent and the legend says which one.
cards.quote:
Four card kinds and no fifth: readout, stack, series, row. A gap in a series is a gap in the line, never a
ramp across the WHO line nobody measured. The node's own words are never uppercased — `µg/m³` once became
`MG/M³` on the hero, a factor of a thousand.
cards.title: Four card kinds and no fifth

cell.more: Resolution 8 is coarser than the rounding already applied to the node's position, so the cell drawn on the ground puts nothing back that the node had held out.
cell.quote:
**The H3 cell.** The node stands in a hexagon of the H3 grid at resolution 8 — an edge of roughly half a
kilometre; 525 m for node #1's cell — printed in the mono as a fifteen-character id such as
`8839446033fffff`, with its edge length beside it.
cell.title: The cell this node stands in

containment.more: That is the documentation's example grain line. The one under the lead is tonight's, read from this node, and when the neighbouring grains give the same answer the page says so.
containment.quote:
At resolution 8 one cell is
0.74 km² and this node's 7 stations fall in 3 of them. 4 sit in this node's own cell, of which 3 are its
own.
containment.title: Exact in the index, approximate on the ground

current.more: A heat alert is a condition that holds for hours; a cooking spike is an event with a cooldown. The schema does not yet know an alert can clear, so the page says which it is.
current.quote:
The dashboard marks
an open act-level ask as *current* only while its condition still holds — the room over the line, or the
alert under two hours old — and otherwise says the reading came back on its own and the ask is still open.
current.title: Conditions that are not events

custody.more: Your own instruments are drawn in ink on this page, the borrowed ones faint, and what only the satellite knows in orange.
custody.quote:
**`custody`.** A generated column: `kind = 'child' OR (local AND kind <> 'peer')`. The only thing a cell may
count, and the thing that may roll up to a parent. Custody splits geography from responsibility: a peer's
station can be closer than your own kit and still never be counted.
custody.title: Custody: who may be counted

dial.more: The stops that may leave the machine are drawn as a dotted texture rather than the cells blue, so blue keeps its one meaning on this page: an H3 cell. Under the dial, a fold draws one cell at the stop you are on against the stops either side, to scale, and what each thing this node speaks for costs to cover at it.
dial.quote:
A **dial** sits under the header: one stop per H3 resolution the node's grain table knows, opening at 8.
Stops coarse enough that the cell may leave the machine (at or above the presence floor,
resolution 6) are shaded with a dotted texture rather than the cells blue; stops finer than the
published resolution are struck through.
dial.title: The dial: one stop per grain

distances.more: The page prints them in the household's words — room, wall outside, street, model — on one scale, so the eye can answer whether it is me or everywhere without arithmetic.
distances.quote:
**The four distances.** Where a reading comes from, nearest first: `room` (local, indoor), `yard` (local,
outdoor), `ring` (somebody else's device near here) and `region` (a model, a portal — what only the models
know). A child node is a fifth place that is not a column. In Bahasa: ruangan · halaman · sekitar · wilayah.
distances.title: Four distances, not four resolutions

lead.more: The node computes and the page draws. A number this page worked out for itself would be a bug, which is why the sentence, the numeral and the state word all arrive from GET /issues.
lead.quote:
The first thing on Now is the headline issue's sentence in the household's language — "Falling to 9
micrograms, under the street, under the model, under the line" — with the kicker naming the issue, a line
saying why, and the ask strip if something is open.
lead.title: The lead

levels.more: An alert's acted_at stays null until a person acts and records it — this page's button, the CLI, the bot, a radio, or an agent. It is the one measurement the node cannot make itself.
levels.quote:
`ALERT_LEVEL` (default `act`) is the floor for interrupting a person. `planetai report level warn` lowers it
without a restart. Below the floor an alert is still recorded, still drawn, and still in the next
[report](report.md).
levels.title: Three levels, one floor

prov.more: Provenance is ink only and square on this page, never a coloured pill, and the full H3 id is printed once per object and never truncated.
prov.quote:
`live` — measured by this node, room or yard. `partial` — derived, a portal, the ring. `model` — a model
row. `cached` — a committed fixture replayed through the node's own engine.
prov.title: Provenance words

raw.more: The barcode under Observe is hourly means of the room's PM2.5 — the finest grain this page shows, and still not a raw reading.
raw.quote:
Raw readings stay. What travels is a summary: hourly means and alert timestamps to a parent node, if there
is one; the daily [export](storage.md) — hourly means by role (`indoor-1`, `outdoor-2`), cells, the first line
of each alert, ρ, the node's position to three decimals — under CC BY 4.0
raw.section: What leaves the machine, and what never does
raw.title: Raw readings stay

refusals.more: The care label at the foot is those refusals as signs. Nothing to press on the wall is the wall's own refusal: it is an instruction, not a control.
refusals.quote:
No raw readings leave the instance that recorded them. No cell is upgraded from `partial` to `live` by
aggregation. No agent dispatches without a human row in `actions`. No layer requires a cloud provider to
function. No scale is skipped: a city aggregator is built from nodes, not declared from above.
refusals.section: Refusals that hold at every stage
refusals.title: Refusals that hold at every stage

rho.more: The page draws it as the asks answered over the asks raised, with the median minutes to the first answer, and counts the rings rather than sizing them.
rho.quote:
ρ (rho) is the share of the node's act-level alerts that led to someone doing something. It is the one
number on the page that comes from a person, the Fab City Index's `Governance` cell at the node's scale, and
the reason the `actions` table is the Index's instrument rather than an app feature.
rho.title: ρ — the loop closed

share.more: The request ledger below is this page confessing what it asked of the world while you looked at it. The offline plan asks nothing; Telegram is reached by the node, never by this page.
share.quote:
`SHARE_LEVEL` is reach, not publishing: it says who on your network may read; it never sends anything
anywhere. Change it in Set up, with `planetai config set SHARE_LEVEL open`, or over MCP; it is live within 20
seconds.
share.title: Reach, not publishing

stages.more: Observe, decide, act, measure — the four stages this page is read in. A section whose data is not on this node prints one honest line in its place, never a blank and never a guess.
stages.quote:
Every section is registered with the page contract — `id`, `pack`, `stage`, `title`, `render`, and
optionally `order`, `needs`, `controls`, `wall`, `notes` — and rendered in the stage it belongs to, in the
order the loop runs
stages.title: The order the loop runs

states.more: State is carried by weight, fill and dash, never by hue — act is set at 800 and quiet at 400. Colour is argument only: blue a cell, green a loop closed, red a line crossed.
states.quote:
For every issue the keeper declared in
`NODE_ISSUES` (an undeclared one is still shown, greyed, as `watched: false`): a `state` — `act` (something
is asked), `notable` (something changed), `quiet`, `context` (an issue that informs and never asks), `none`
(no record)
states.title: States, in weight not hue

tiles.more: The request count sits in the tab bar so the price of switching to satellite is visible before you pay it: live tiles need MAP_TILES=on, and a press may only ever reduce it.
tiles.title: What a map costs
